# Ecclesiastes Chapter 12 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**12:1** And-remember [u-zekhor] your-Creator [et bor'ekha] in-the-days [bi-yemei] of-your-youth [bechurotekha], until [ad] that [asher] the-days [yemei] of-evil [ha-ra'ah] come-not [lo yavo'u], and-the-years [ve-higgi'u shanim] arrive when [asher] you-will-say [tomar]: "There-is-no [ein] desire [chefetz] in-them [li bahem]."

**12:2** Until [ad] that [asher] the-sun [ha-shemesh] and-the-light [ve-ha-or] and-the-moon [ve-ha-yare'ach] and-the-stars [ve-ha-kokhavim] are-not-darkened [lo yechshekhu], and-the-clouds [he-avim] return [ve-shavu] after the-rain [ha-gashem].

**12:3** In-the-day [be-yom] when the-keepers [shomrei] of-the-house [ha-bayit] tremble [she-yazu'u], and-the-men [anshei] of-strength [ha-chayil] are-bent [ve-hit'avvetu], and-the-grinders [ve-hatelu ha-tochanot] cease [ki mi'etu], and-the-ones-who-look [ve-chashekhu ha-ro'ot] through-the-windows [ba-arubot] grow-dim [ki mi'etu],

**12:4** and-the-doors [ve-suggeru dlatayim] are-shut [ba-shuq] in-the-street [bi-shfal], when-the-sound [qol] of-the-grinding [ha-techanah] is-low [bi-shfal]; and-one-rises [ve-yaqum] at-the-voice [le-qol] of-the-bird [ha-tzippor], and-all the-daughters [benot] of-song [ha-shir] are-brought-low [yishshachu].

**12:5** Also from-the-height [mi-gavo'ah] they-are-afraid [yira'u], and-terrors [ve-chatchtuchim] [are] in-the-way [ba-derekh]; and-the-almond-tree [ha-shaqed] blossoms [yane'etz], and-the-grasshopper [ha-chagav] drags-itself [yistabbel], and-desire [ha-aviyyonah] fails [ve-tafer]; for the-human [ha-adam] goes [holekh] to his-eternal-home [el beit olamo], and-the-mourners [ve-savevu ba-shuq ha-sofedim] go-about in-the-street.

**12:6** Before [ad asher lo] the-silver [ha-kesef] cord [chevel] is-snapped [yeratheq], and-the-golden [ha-zahav] bowl [gullat] is-crushed [terutz], and-the-jar [ve-tishaver ha-kad] is-broken [al] at-the-spring [ha-mabbu'a], and-the-wheel [ve-ha-galgal] is-shattered [narotz] at the-cistern [el ha-bor].

**12:7** And-the-dust [ve-ha-afar] returns [yashuv] to the-earth [al ha-aretz] as-it-was [ke-she-hayah], and-the-spirit [ve-ha-ruach] returns [tashuv] to the-God [el ha-Elohim] who gave-it [asher netanah].

**12:8** Vapor-of-vapors [havel havalim], says [amar] Qoheleth [ha-qoheleth]; all [ha-kol] [is] vapor [havel].

**12:9** And-besides [ve-yoter] that [she-] Qoheleth [qoheleth] was [hayah] wise [chakham], he-also [od] taught [limmed] the-people [et ha-am] knowledge [da'at]; and-he-pondered [ve-izzen] and-searched-out [ve-chiqqer] [and] set-in-order [tiqqen] many [harbeh] proverbs [meshalim].

**12:10** Qoheleth [qoheleth] sought [biqqesh] to-find [limtzo] words [divrei] of-delight [chefetz], and-what-was-written [ve-khatuv] [was] upright [yosher] — words [divrei] of-truth [emet].

**12:11** The-words [divrei] of-the-wise [chakhamim] [are] like-goads [ka-dorbanot], and-like-nails [u-khe-masmerot] planted [netu'im] [are the] masters [ba'alei] of-collections [asuppot]; they-are-given [nittenu] from-one [me-] shepherd [ro'eh echad].

**12:12** And-beyond [ve-yoter] these [me-hemmah], my-son [beni], be-warned [hizzaher]: of-making [asot] many [harbeh] books [sefarim] there-is-no [ein] end [qetz], and-much [ve-lahag harbeh] study [is] a-weariness [yegi'at] of-the-flesh [basar].

**12:13** The-end [sof] of-the-matter [davar]; all [ha-kol] has-been-heard [nishma]. Fear [et ha-Elohim yera] God and-keep [u-shemor] his-commandments [mitzvotav], for this [ki zeh] [is] the-whole [kol] of-the-human [ha-adam].

**12:14** For every [kol] work [ma'aseh] God [ha-Elohim] will-bring [yavi] into-judgment [ve-mishpat], concerning-every [al kol] hidden-thing [ne'lam], whether [im] good [tov] or [ve-im] evil [ra].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "your Creator" (bor'ekha):** Some scholars emend to *be'erekha* ("your well/cistern" = wife, cf. Prov 5:15) or *borrekha* ("your pit" = grave). EMET follows the MT: *bor'ekha* = "your Creator."

**vv.3-5 — The aging allegory:** This is the most sustained allegory in the Hebrew Bible. The "keepers of the house" (arms), "men of strength" (legs), "grinders" (teeth), "those looking through windows" (eyes), "doors shut in the street" (ears/lips), "daughters of song brought low" (voice), "the almond tree blossoms" (white hair), "the grasshopper drags itself" (slow movement), "desire fails" (appetite/libido). EMET preserves the coded imagery without decoding it.

**v.6 — The four images of death:** Silver cord, golden bowl, broken jar, shattered wheel — four images of beautiful, functional things breaking irreparably. These likely represent the cessation of bodily functions.

**v.8 — "Vapor of vapors":** The book's motto returns as its final verdict. The inclusio with 1:2 frames the entire work.

**vv.9-14 — The epilogue:** Written in the third person about Qoheleth, not by him. Most scholars identify this as an editorial addition by a later hand. Its function — framing radical questioning within conventional piety ("fear God and keep his commandments") — may have facilitated the book's acceptance into the canon.

*-- EMET*
